product_one_liner.value: Haptiq provides an AI-powered enterprise operations platform that unifies business data, automates execution, and surfaces decision insights for public and private companies, asset managers, governments, institutions, and family offices.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation/footer has no pricing link, and the contact page is a contact form rather than a pricing page.

named_customers.notes: Both appear in the homepage logo wall under “Trusted by teams who don’t wait.”

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn reports 297 employees, which falls in the 201-500 band.

hq_location.notes: Haptiq identifies its headquarters as New York City; its company profile locates it in New York, United States.

founded_year.notes: PitchBook reports Haptiq was founded in 2009.

eng_blog.notes: The index is mainly business/product insight articles and updates; it shows one clearly software-engineering-specific observability post, not two engineering-authored technical posts.

public_docs.notes: The site links to an FAQ but no product documentation, help center, or developer portal; the reviewed FAQ is a single FAQ page.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live company job board showed no current opportunities.

model_provider.notes: The reviewed product FAQ and blog do not identify a model provider; the DPA says the current subprocessor list is supplied upon request rather than publishing it.

compliance_certs.notes: The reviewed legal pages do not claim SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS certification. The DPA mentions SOC 2 Type II only as an example of an audit standard, not as a Haptiq certification.

last_funding.notes: The latest identified transaction was Pearl Street Equity’s April 2022 investment/buyout; the amount is undisclosed. The schema requires a numeric amount, so 0 is a neutral placeholder, not a reported deal amount.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified investment/buyout occurred in April 2022, before the 18-month window ending November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live company job board showed no current openings, including no SDR, BDR, or account executive posting.

launched_6mo.notes: The May 28, 2026 update announces new Orion connectors and Olympus compliance-engine capabilities, within the six months before November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Bhuvan Khanna’s profile identifies his Haptiq role as General Manager and Chief Product Officer and shows it ended in May 2026, within the requested 12-month period.

crm_stack_signal.notes: A Haptiq sales job description names Salesforce and HubSpot as CRM platforms for which experience is relevant; it does not independently confirm which one Haptiq has deployed.
